_doc: An A4988 stepper driver module on the StepStick footprint, as made by Pololu (its 2017 and later boards, Rs = 0.068 ohm). Pololu's figures are spec. Board and row sizes are community: they match Pololu's DRV8825 drawing, which says its module size and pinout follow the A4988's. Clone boards differ most in their sense resistor, so read the variants, and every clone figure is community until measured. Board in the x-y plane, the header rows along x.
name: a4988

red-clone-R100.source: most unbranded red boards use 0.1 ohm; read the resistor on yours, https://zbotic.in/stepper-motor-current-setting-a4988-vref-calculation-guide/

current_bare.rule: Continuous per coil, about, with no heat sink or moving air

current_cooled.rule: Most per coil, with sufficient added cooling

sense_resistor.rule: Sense resistor on the boards made since 2017 (older green boards 0.050)

vref_formula.rule: The current limit from the voltage on the trimmer. In full step each coil carries about 0.7 of the limit

vref_gain.rule: Limit per volt of Vref: 1 / (8 * 0.068). 0.8 V sets 1.47 A

microsteps.rule: Full down to sixteenth, set with MS1, MS2 and MS3

max_microsteps.rule: The finest division of a full step

thermal_shutdown.rule: The chip stops above this temperature, typically, with 15 degrees of hysteresis

pin_pitch.rule: Pin spacing along a header row (0.1 in)

row_spacing.rule: Between the two header rows (0.5 in), from the DRV8825 carrier

pin_count.rule: Pins in all, eight to a row

body_width.rule: Board length along the header rows, from the DRV8825 drawing; measure a clone

body_depth.rule: Board width across the rows, from the DRV8825 drawing; measure a clone

pinout.value: EN MS1 MS2 MS3 RST SLP STEP DIR | VMOT GND 2B 2A 1A 1B VDD GND
pinout.rule: The two rows, each from one end to the other. Tie RST to SLP to enable the board. Compare with your board's silkscreen
